description: Fire hazards expressed as failure modes, with qualitative review priority.

records.failure_mode: Smoke enters the single stair during evacuation
records.failure_effect: Escape route compromised for occupants above the fire floor, including sleeping residents
records.failure_cause: Stair protection and evacuation assumptions were made for awake, familiar office occupants
records.action_priority_method: a qualitative review priority assigned in the SIMULATED dataset; it is not a quantified fire risk assessment

records.failure_mode: Residents are not warned in time
records.failure_cause: Detection and cause-and-effect were designed for office occupancy
records.action_priority_method: a qualitative review priority assigned in the SIMULATED dataset; it is not a quantified fire risk assessment

records.failure_mode: Fire and smoke spread from a flat into common circulation
records.failure_cause: Flat entrance doorsets not yet specified to a residential performance
records.action_priority_method: a qualitative review priority assigned in the SIMULATED dataset; it is not a quantified fire risk assessment

records.failure_mode: Compartment floor breached by new service penetrations
records.failure_effect: Fire spread between Level 3 and adjacent storeys

records.action_priority_method: a qualitative review priority assigned in the SIMULATED dataset; it is not a quantified fire risk assessment

records.failure_mode: Fire in an unsprinklered flat grows beyond the fire size assumed in the strategy
